inlineMarkup.why: The stored value of these text fields carries markup around or between its words: an accent span or a line break in a heading, a styled unit span in a price, a paragraph wrapper around a body. Each such field declares it (inline): the emphasis shape the demo value carries, read from the template kit, and the block elements wrapping the words. The build keeps the wrapper, the writer supplies words plus an optional emphasis part, the build wraps that part the way the demo does, and plain words are always valid.

owners.#597: writes such a value: the words, plus the optional emphasis part the field declares, wrapped the way the demo does (the content map's ((br/)) and ((span)) markers), inside the wrapper elements the field declares; never markup the writer returns
owners.#585: the gate that catches a broken look when such a value is written: an emphasis part left out of its span, a wrapper lost, raw markers printed

notes.block-165.description: Running rich text, not a child list: each step's stored value is a body, one paragraph followed by a highlight list (ul.list-highlight, five lines in each of the four stored values), and its limit was measured on that whole body. The list is a part of the body's markup, kept with the paragraph by the owners of this class, not a list of rows of the step.
notes.block-180.person-bio: Running rich text, not a child list: the trainer's stored biography is one paragraph followed by a highlight list (ul.list-highlight h4, four lines), and its limit was measured on that whole body. The list is a part of the body's markup, kept with the paragraph by the owners of this class, not a list of rows of the trainer.
